summary: 真人影像（FMV）冒险游戏，2026 年 9 月 11 日上市，MYSTERY CROWN 与 YESPLAY 开发、MYSTERY CROWN 发行。商店 AI 披露只有一句覆盖全部游戏内素材的总量式声明（中文“游戏中的所有素材均通过AI生成”＋英文 All in-game materials are generated by AI.），没有逐项说明；本站据此把美术登记为已使用，其余七个领域记为披露未说明。同一商店页的简介另有一句 All characters in the game feature real human voice acting.，与披露栏不同向，两处原文均照录、不做判定。
reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 MYSTERY CROWN、YESPLAY，发行商 MYSTERY CROWN）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 35）。首页有 1 个命中 AI 关键词的主题“This is an AI movie. Not a game.”，已读取全帖：发帖人抱怨本作被归入“Video games with real actors”类型却看不到真人演员，回帖者互相引用商店简介里“All characters in the game feature real human voice acting.”一句，并要求其他玩家去看片尾字幕，还有人讨论 AI 影像与真实照片已难区分。全帖没有带开发方身份的回复，都是玩家立场与引用，按规则只登记不判定，不改变任何领域结论。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 2 篇原始来源：HowMuchAI 本作条目逐字复刻商店披露，并自述本作还没有按领域拆分；GameAICheck 本作条目把开发者自述概括为覆盖美术、音频与文本，给出由 deepseek-flash 生成的“AI judgment”，并统计该开发商近 12 个月发行 19 款、名下 33 款中 30 款披露 AI——这些是该站的模型判断与统计，不构成独立核实，本站不采纳。其余 4 条为本作商店页与折扣入口、本作试玩版商店页（App ID 4719920，按政策试玩版不充新增）以及一个德语社区入口页；另有一个 Reddit 讨论帖，本机直连与代理两条通道都无法完成 TLS 握手，全文未能读取，因此没有登记为来源。领域判定全部来自商店披露栏原文，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
description: 一段分支式真人影像冒险：玩家操控两名主角，靠选择与 QTE 解锁不同分支与结局，跟着能预见灾难的少女和来自未来的军官拼出病毒爆发的源头。

english.summary: An FMV adventure released on Sep 11, 2026, developed by MYSTERY CROWN and YESPLAY and published by MYSTERY CROWN. The Steam AI disclosure is a single blanket statement, one Chinese line followed by the English line All in-game materials are generated by AI., which sweeps all in-game materials together and itemises nothing; this site therefore records the art area as used on that sentence and records the other seven areas as not addressed rather than guessing what the blanket wording covers. The same store page description also carries the sentence All characters in the game feature real human voice acting., which does not point the same way as the disclosure block; both are logged as written and neither is adjudicated.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developers MYSTERY CROWN and YESPLAY, publisher MYSTERY CROWN) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 35), where one topic matches the AI keyword search, titled This is an AI movie. Not a game. It was opened and read in full: the opening post complains that the game is filed under the Video games with real actors genre while the writer sees no real actors, replies quote the store description sentence about all characters having real human voice acting and tell other players to check the end credits, and others discuss how hard it has become to tell AI imagery from a real photo. Nobody writing with a developer identity replies, so these are player opinions and quotations, logged without changing any area finding. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 2 raw sources were read. The first is a HowMuchAI entry for this game that reproduces the store disclosure verbatim and states on the page that this game has not been split by area yet. The second is a GameAICheck entry for this game that summarises the developer statement as covering art, audio and text, prints an AI judgment produced by deepseek-flash, and counts 19 releases by this publisher in the last 12 months with 30 of their 33 games disclosing AI; that is that site model output plus its own statistics, not independent verification, so this site does not adopt it. The other 4 results were the store page and discount entry for this game, the demo store page for this game (App ID 4719920, which policy excludes from new intake) and a German community entry page. One further Reddit thread about this game could not be read at all: neither the direct route nor the local proxy completed a TLS handshake, so it is not registered as a source. Every area finding comes from the disclosure block on the store page and rests on the developer own statement, without an independent audit.
